messages.content: [User Role: ADMIN]
How do I review and approve pending farmer applications on the Admin Dashboard?

Navigate to the Admin Governance Portal under 'User Approvals'. Filter by role 'Farmer' and status 'Pending'. Click on the farmer's application to review their name, farm address, and encrypted bank details. If verified, click 'Approve'. Their account status will transition to `approved`, granting them access to list inventory.
[User Role: ADMIN]
A customer has received multiple complaints for filing fraudulent refund requests on fresh produce.

Review the customer's dispute history under 'Dispute Management'. Check the evidence photos, order frequency, and refund ratios. If fraudulent activity is confirmed, you can escalate by setting their user status to `suspended`.
What happens when I suspend their account?
Setting status to `suspended` immediately invalidates all active session tokens, logs them out, and blocks them from logging in or placing future orders across Auxin.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How do I resolve a customer dispute #402 and trigger a Razorpay refund?

Open Dispute #402 in the Admin Dashboard. Review the customer's claim (e.g. damaged produce photo) and farmer response. Set dispute status to `resolved` and check the 'Trigger Refund' box. The backend will invoke `POST /payments/refund` via Razorpay API, updating payment status to `refunded` and returning escrow funds to the customer.
[User Role: ADMIN]
A farmer submitted a request to add 'Dragonfruit' to the Master Catalogue.

Milo — The AI Assistant for Auxin. To approve the request, go to Catalogue Management > Product Requests on the Admin Portal. Click 'Approve Request'. This creates a new entry in `master_products` under the 'Fruits' category with canonical images and allowed units ('kg', 'piece').
Will all farmers be able to list Dragonfruit now?
Yes! Once created in `master_products`, any approved farmer can list their Dragonfruit harvest under this master item, keeping the marketplace unified without duplicate cards.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How do I add a new subcategory under 'Vegetables' in the 2-level category hierarchy?

Go to Catalogue > Category Manager. Click 'Add Category'. Enter name (e.g. 'Microgreens'), slug ('microgreens'), and select 'Vegetables' as the `parent_id`. Assign an emoji icon (e.g. 🌱) and display order. Click 'Save' to publish the new subcategory.
[User Role: ADMIN]
Where can I view platform telemetry charts for weekly revenue and daily order volume?

Platform telemetry charts are available on the main Admin Dashboard overview tab. It features four primary real-time charts: 1. Weekly Revenue (sum of completed escrow releases), 2. Weekly Orders Trend, 3. Hourly Activity Distribution (order density by time buckets), and 4. Daily User Registrations.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How do I verify a new delivery partner's driving license and vehicle details?

Go to User Approvals > Filter by 'Delivery Partner'. Click on the applicant's record to inspect their driving license number, vehicle type (e.g. Motorcycle), registration number, and bank account info. Click 'Approve' to activate their courier status.
[User Role: ADMIN]
What should I do if a farmer applicant submits an invalid IFSC code?

Click on the farmer's application in User Approvals, select 'Reject', and input the reason: 'Invalid IFSC code provided for bank details'. The applicant will receive an SMS notification asking them to update their bank details and re-submit.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How can I audit transaction logs to check escrow releases vs refunds?

Go to Financial Audits > Transaction Logs on the Admin Portal. You can filter transactions by type: `release` (funds paid to farmer upon OTP completion) or `refund` (funds returned to customer upon order cancellation/dispute resolution). Each log displays the associated payment ID, order ID, amount, and timestamp.
[User Role: ADMIN]
A courier reported persistent geofence mismatch errors because a new apartment building GPS was misaligned.

Check the courier's location log and the customer's delivery coordinate in Dispute & Operations support. If verified, an admin can manually override the geofence validation for that specific order ID, allowing the courier to enter the customer's OTP and complete delivery.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How does Auxin moderate stale or expired farmer inventory?

Auxin runs an automated daily cleanup job that deactivates `farmer_inventory` listings where `harvest_date` is older than 30 days. Admins can also manually trigger the cleanup query from the Admin Maintenance panel to remove expired produce listings.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How do I monitor active escrow holds across all current orders?

Go to Escrow Operations in the Admin Dashboard. The dashboard displays the total active monetary value currently held in escrow (`payment.status = 'paid'`), along with a list of active orders awaiting delivery OTP completion.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How do I send a broadcast announcement to all active delivery partners regarding heavy rainfall?

Go to Broadcast & Notifications on the Admin Portal. Click 'Create Notification', select target role 'Delivery Partner', enter title 'Weather Alert: Heavy Rain', and message text detailing SLA extensions and safety precautions. Tap 'Send Broadcast'.
[User Role: ADMIN]
What steps should I take if a farmer submits suspected fake identity documents?

Select the application in User Approvals, click 'Reject Application', and set account status to `rejected`. Add an internal forensic note detailing the document anomaly for audit records. The user will be blocked from resubmitting with those details.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How do I reinstate a farmer account that was previously suspended?

Go to User Management > Filter by Status 'Suspended'. Search for the farmer's profile, review compliance resolution notes, and click 'Reinstate Account'. Their status will update to `approved`, restoring access to their inventory and dashboard.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How do I manually cancel a stuck order where neither farmer nor courier is responding?

Open Order Operations on the Admin Portal, find the order ID, and click 'Force Cancel'. Select cancellation reason 'SLA Timeout'. The backend will update order status to `cancelled`, release the escrow hold, and trigger a Razorpay refund to the customer.
[User Role: ADMIN]
What should I do if two duplicate master products exist for 'Basmati Rice'?

Go to Catalogue Manager > Master Products. Identify the duplicate entry, re-map any active `farmer_inventory` rows to the canonical `master_product_id`, and deactivate or delete the duplicate record to maintain catalogue integrity.
[User Role: ADMIN]
Where can I view user sign-up trends for customers vs farmers?

Navigate to Dashboard > Analytics > User Registrations. The chart displays a daily breakdown of new account creations categorized by role (Customer, Farmer, Delivery Partner) over the selected timeframe.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How do I edit the allowed units array for a master product like Milk?

Open Catalogue Manager > Master Products, select 'Cow Milk', and edit `allowed_units`. You can check or uncheck unit enums (e.g. `litre`, `500ml`, `200ml`). Farmers listing milk will only be able to choose from these approved units.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How do I suspend a delivery partner who has received multiple safety reports?

Navigate to User Management > Delivery Partners, search for the courier, click 'Manage Account', and set status to `suspended`. Enter the safety incident details in the audit log. Their availability will immediately be set to offline.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How does the admin system handle encrypted bank details during payout processing?
The backend decrypts the Fernet-encrypted bank account strings in memory only during batch transfer generation for approved payout releases. Decrypted numbers are never logged in plain text.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How do I review reported spam produce listings?

Go to Moderation > Reported Listings on the Admin Dashboard. Review flagged items (e.g. unreasonable pricing or inappropriate notes). Click 'Deactivate Inventory' to remove the listing from public search and send a notification to the farmer.
[User Role: ADMIN]
What is the difference between Admin and Super Admin roles in Auxin?

Admins manage user approvals, order disputes, customer refunds, and catalogue moderation. Super Admins have elevated privileges including system environment configurations, database migration tools, and master admin account management.
[User Role: ADMIN]
What happens if a Razorpay payment webhook fails?

The Admin Dashboard highlights unverified transactions in Payment Audits > Webhook Logs. Admins can click 'Re-verify Payment Signature' to manually trigger the verification check against Razorpay APIs and complete order processing.
[User Role: ADMIN]
How do I export monthly marketplace transactions for financial auditing?

Go to Reports & Audits > Export Center. Select date range (e.g. Previous Month), select report type ('Transactions & Escrow Releases'), and click 'Export CSV'. The report includes order IDs, payment methods, escrow release timestamps, and refund totals.
[User Role: ADMIN]

[User Role: ADMIN]

Go to Financial Audits > Transaction Logs. Filter by transaction type (`release` for completed delivery payouts or `refund` for customer returns). Each record shows payment ID, order ID, amount, and timestamp.
